# Project Introduction Deck Template
# Used by /present when --template intro is specified

## Slide mapping

| Source section | Slide type | Notes |
|---------------|-----------|-------|
| # {Project Name} | title-slide | Logo, tagline, date |
| ## What is this? | content-slide | 2-3 sentences from README |
| ## The Problem | content-slide | What problem does it solve |
| ## The Solution | content-slide | How ORCH/this project solves it |
| ## Architecture | diagram-slide | C4 Level 1 or 2 diagram |
| ## Tech Stack | content-slide | Library × version × usage table |
| ## Key Features | content-slide | Bulleted highlights |
| ## Demo | content-slide | Screenshots or key flows |
| ## Getting Started | content-slide | Setup steps |
| ## What's Next | content-slide | Roadmap / next steps |

## Data sources

- README.md
- PROJECT.md (if exists)
- package.json
- .github/agents/ and .github/skills/ for ORCH features
